description: Typed local times at daylight-saving changes and the exact UTC instant each stands for, by the one rule in ui-conventions#schedules (#1129): a repeated time is its first occurrence; a skipped time is the first instant after the gap. tests/stewardship/test_browser_local_times.py pins web.dates.browser_instant and campaigns.intervals.resolve_local to them; tests/stewardship/browser/test_schedule_fields.py pins the page script's ParishLocalTime.moment.

cases.why: New York springs forward on March 8, 2026: 2:00 EST becomes 3:00 EDT.
New York falls back on November 1, 2026: 1:00-2:00 happens twice; the first (EDT) is used, and 2:00 is EST.
Sydney springs forward on October 4, 2026: 2:00 AEST becomes 3:00 AEDT.
Sydney falls back on April 5, 2026: 2:00-3:00 happens twice; the first (AEDT, UTC+11) is used, and 3:00 is AEST.
Lord Howe springs forward 30 minutes on October 4, 2026 (+10:30 to +11): 2:15 is the first instant after the half-hour gap.
It falls back 30 minutes on April 5, 2026: the first 1:45 (+11).
Santiago springs forward at midnight on September 6, 2026 (00:00 -04 becomes 01:00 -03): 00:30 is the first instant after the gap.
